item.title: Christopher Nolan Says Fans Will Never See Deleted Scenes From 'The Odyssey': "I Want To Stand By The Film That Goes Out"
item.description: For those expecting deleted scenes on the home video release of Christopher Nolan 's " The Odyssey ,' here's some bad news. Variety reports that while there are "a lot of" them, they're not available on any of the new discs that hit stores this past Tuesday. And the scenes will never see the light of day either, because, as Nolan told The Independent in a new interview, "I don't really believe in director's cuts." READ MORE: Steven Spielberg Says 'The Odyssey' Is "One Of The Greatest Things" Matt Damon "Has Ever Done As An Actor," Also Praises Samantha Morton "There's a lot of deleted scenes scrumbled up in the wastebasket that no one will ever see," the director told the British outlet. Continue reading Christopher Nolan Says Fans Will Never See Deleted Scenes From 'The Odyssey': "I Want To Stand By The Film That Goes Out" at The Playlist.
